info.title: Finnhub API
info.description: Subset of the Finnhub REST API used by tickr. One-time migration of the upstream Swagger 2.0 dump (the ~577 KB schema/finnhub.io/swagger.json) to OpenAPI 3.0, trimmed to the endpoints tickr actually consumes. Only GET /quote is retained: on the free plan it is the sole usable stock-price endpoint (GET /stock/candle returns HTTP 403 NOT_AUTHORIZED on free, so no intraday candles are available). Docs: https://finnhub.io/docs/api.

get.description: Real-time quote data for US stocks. tickr uses this to capture each session's official close early: after the 16:00-ET close, `c` (current price) settles to the official regular-session close and does NOT drift with after-hours (empirically verified — value frozen across repeated post-close polls), which is the property the early weekly-close capture (TODO/30) relies on. Day OHLC (`o`/`h`/`l`), previous close (`pc`), and a quote timestamp (`t`) are also returned. Constant polling is discouraged by Finnhub; tickr polls once per symbol per post-close run under a token bucket.

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Symbol. tickr passes its stored symbol as-is; Finnhub accepts both dotted and dashed class shares (e.g. BRK.B and BRK-B resolve identically).

api_key.name: token
api_key.description: Pass your Finnhub API key as the `token` query parameter: ?token=<FINNHUB_API_KEY>. Read from env; never logged.

c.description: Current price. After the regular-session close, this holds the official close.

t.description: Quote timestamp (UNIX seconds) of the last update. Present in the live response though absent from the upstream Swagger schema; retained here because the capture job uses it to confirm the quote belongs to the just-closed session.
